sources.entry: AUHost - Application which hosts AudioUnits v3 using AVFoundation API.

summary.one_liner: AUHost.app is a standalone macOS application that loads and plays audio through AudioUnit v3 plug-ins registered on the system.
summary.what_it_does: The app hosts AudioUnits v3 effect plug-ins built on the AVFoundation API. Its playback graph is simple: an audio file feeds an optional effect, which feeds the main output. The main window has three tables: available effects, presets, and songs from the iTunes library. Selecting an effect inserts it into the playback graph. Selecting a preset activates the corresponding factory preset for that effect. A signed and notarized binary is published on the Releases page. The README does not describe other features.
use_cases: apply an audio effect to a song
try factory presets of an AU plug-in
play iTunes library tracks through an effect
host AudioUnit plug-ins outside a DAW
how_to_run: Download the signed and notarized binary from the Releases page
To build from source, use Xcode 13 or later as stated in the README
stack: Swift or Objective-C (not named in README)
notable: Hosts AudioUnit v3 plug-ins registered in the macOS system
Simple graph: file, optional effect, main output
Browses songs from the iTunes library
caveats: Requires Xcode 13 to build from source
Feature scope is minimal; the README describes only basic playback and effect insertion
Built on macOS and AVFoundation, so it works only on Apple platforms
